name: Virtual machine
summary: Linux or Windows virtual machine with no public IP, Entra ID login, trusted launch, encryption at host, platform patching and optional data disks.
useWhen: You need full control of the OS or must run software that cannot be containerized or run on PaaS
You migrate an existing server workload
You need a jump host, build agent or utility VM inside your VNet
avoidWhen: A PaaS service fits (App Service, Container Apps, Azure SQL) and you do not need OS access
You need many identical instances with autoscale (use a virtual machine scale set)
